Class DefaultNotifier

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.substrate.core.notifier.DefaultNotifier
All Implemented Interfaces:
Notifier
public class DefaultNotifier extends Object implements Notifier
Default Notifier, routing every primitive's notifications over a single NotifierSpi transport by encoding the primitive, key and kind into the payload.
